meta.title: eSIM Catalogue · MyBestSim Dashboard
meta.description: Key statistics of the eSIM catalogue imported daily from supplier CSV files.

meanData.label: Average data per card
meanData.hint: Across {limited} plans with a data cap. The {unlimited} unlimited plans are excluded: an infinite amount cannot be averaged, and counting them as 0 GB would skew the result.

meanPrice.label: Average price
meanPrice.hint: Median: {median}. Unlimited plans pull the average up.

providers.title: Breakdown by provider
providers.subtitle: Number of cards offered by each provider

competitiveness.title: Price competitiveness
competitiveness.subtitle: Median gap between the provider's price and the market median for the same plan (same data, same validity). Negative = cheaper than the market.
competitiveness.insight: Every provider is within ±{max} of the market: price is driven by the plan you pick, not by the provider.
competitiveness.whyNotPerGb: Why not the average price per GB? It penalises providers that sell many small plans, because a GB costs more on a 1 GB plan than on a 50 GB plan. With that metric, 4S eSIM would look the most expensive although it is priced at market level.

grid.title: Median price grid
grid.subtitle: Median price by data allowance and validity period

import.title: Import today's CSV files
import.description: Drop one or more supplier files. Each file replaces its provider's catalogue; other providers are kept. Files are processed in your browser: nothing is sent to a server.
